n1cff027d63.headline: Marunich: The price under "Rotterdam Plus" is lower than the actual prices of coal imported here
n1cff027d63.summary: The 'Rotterdam Plus' pricing formula no longer covers the real costs of coal imports to Ukraine, as actual prices have risen above the formula's level.
n1cff027d63.why: Energy pricing formulas affect electricity costs and energy sector profitability, influencing inflation and industrial competitiveness.
